values.subject: HR：Review Comments and Three Points Requiring Supplementation
values.body_text: Keep the business-understanding section; it was done well. Three points are still missing: first, clearly explain the intensity of the visit, including how long participants will be standing and walking and whether they can leave midway; second, write the photography boundaries in language that members can understand, rather than simply saying photography is prohibited; third, summarize the personnel information provided externally by number and category, without stating who specifically has what circumstances. Complete it and send me another version.
